scripts.test:ci: vitest run --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile=tmp/vitest-count.json && node -e "const r=require('./tmp/vitest-count.json'); console.log('=== Test count: ' + r.numTotalTests + ' cases / ' + r.numPassedTests + ' passed (README/AGENTS reference) ===')"
scripts.package: npm run build && python3 scripts/package.py --root dist
scripts.package:edge: npm run build && python3 scripts/package.py --root dist --target edge
